entries.1070764d3b553e20: It provides "OPTiM Contract," which uses AI to obtain contract information and streamline contract management; "OPTiM Electronic Books Storage," which uses AI to obtain and store transaction information such as invoices and receipts; and "OPTiM Document Management," which uses AI to analyze and automatically classify various documents. Amounts are not separately disclosed and are therefore not stated.
entries.20a19364c7ea84c0: Centered on "OPTiM Biz," a device management service that enables smartphones, tablets and PCs to be configured and operated collectively from the cloud, the company provides "OPTiM Biz Premium," which integrates device management, SaaS management, ID management and an in-house IT support AI agent; "OPTiM AIRES," an AI agent-type chatbot; and the "Optimal Remote" series of remote IT support centered on screen sharing. Amounts are not separately disclosed and are therefore not stated.
entries.309451f9d89c7783: Using smart agriculture that employs AI and drones, the company produces, distributes and sells crops, including smart rice. Amounts are not separately disclosed and are therefore not stated.
entries.395ad2d29b209fa4: Construction and Civil Engineering AX Services
entries.60b79d219a249b2a: Centered on the platform "Agri Buddy," which supports every stage from cultivation to sales, the company provides services such as pesticide spraying using drones, and is shifting agriculture from a model in which producers handle all stages to a division-of-labor model. Amounts are not separately disclosed and are therefore not stated.
entries.6121e74038d5eba9: It is a business centered on license sales based on a platform business. On the platform "OPTiM AIR," it provides AX services for the information systems, construction and civil engineering, medical, office and communication fields, along with other services such as video analysis. The main customer information in the "Related Information" section names KDDI Corporation as a major customer. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,092 million.
entries.7b0b876cfff9b017: A company that uses AI, IoT and robotics technologies to provide platform services that support corporate DX, and smart agriculture services.
entries.938ec20945fb25c3: It is a service development platform "OPTiM AIR" (formerly OPTiM Cloud IoT OS) that provides common functions needed to develop DX and AX services, such as ID management, IoT management, operational infrastructure and license management. Each AX service is developed on this platform. Amounts are not separately disclosed and are therefore not stated.
entries.96268bf5662b3a1f: It provides "OPTiM AI Camera" series, which analyzes camera footage with AI; a consumer service offering unlimited use of PC software for a fixed fee; and "Tabho," an unlimited e-magazine reading service. Amounts are not separately disclosed and are therefore not stated.
entries.d855178bcdbea12c: It provides "OPTiM Geo Scan," which enables one person to carry out everything from surveying, measurement and design to construction management and inspection support using a smartphone. It can perform positioning with high precision in millimeter units and create 3D data. Amounts are not separately disclosed and are therefore not stated.
entries.f16bd9513c21cc6c: It is a business providing smart agriculture services that support every stage from crop cultivation to sales. It provides cultivation support services using the platform "Agri Buddy," services such as pesticide spraying by drone, and the production, distribution and sale of crops, including smart rice grown with smart agriculture. The consolidated subsidiaries OPTiM AGRI MICHINOKU Co., Ltd. and OPTiM FARM Co., Ltd. provide services using the company's smart agriculture solutions. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,639 million.
entries.f1a14ff613d7893a: It provides "MINS," a network support system that supports the operation of surgical support robot systems, and "OPTiM AI Hospital," which works with electronic medical record systems to support physicians and nurses in document preparation. Amounts are not separately disclosed and are therefore not stated.
